envelope.description: Add optional narrative/description fields to the four definitions and every schema that validates them

body.title: Add optional narrative/description fields to the four definitions and every schema that validates them
body.summary: Extend ErDefinition/ErClass/ErSlot, SequenceDefinition/participants/messages, ComponentDependencyDefinition/components (+ path), UxDefinition/elements/actions with optional narrative/description; mirror them in the four *_PROPERTY_SCHEMA objects AND the vendored closed linkml-metamodel.schema.json and adaptive-cards.schema.json; update the four *_CONTENT_GATE_RULE strings to ask for a narrative and per-element descriptions.
acceptanceChecks: A definition of each kind carrying narrative + descriptions gets no HIGH from its validate*Definition.
A sound definition without the new fields still returns [] from every validator.
The design.story and design.epic synthesizer schemas expose the new optional fields.

tests.name: er/ux/sequence/component validators: described definition (narrative + descriptions) -> no HIGH
body-fields / ux-body-fields: synth property schemas admit narrative + description
